name: Scintillating Eye
description: Magical, kaleidoscopic light emanates from one of the creature’s eyes as the creature targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 6 (1d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
